home.title: What's it worth?
home.subtitle: Take a photo. Valyo identifies the item and estimates its value — new and second-hand, when possible.
home.anyObject: Any object — if there isn't enough evidence to estimate it honestly, we'll tell you.
home.noInvention: An indicative estimate, with its sources and its limits.

example.label: Illustrative example
example.basis: Based on 3 real listings and sales found online
example.limit: The range depends on the camera's actual condition, which can't be verified from a single photo.

result.generalEstimateCaveat: Based on similar items, not on a search for this exact model — take it with a grain of salt.
result.noPriceText: No price available for this item — the references found weren't enough to give an honest estimate.
result.sourcesCaveat: Asking prices (listings) unless noted otherwise — never shown as confirmed sales without explicit proof. Date not guaranteed: these prices come from a web search and may not reflect today's market.
result.wrongObject: Wrong item, or something to add?
result.correctionLabel: Tell us what's off (e.g. “it's an Adidas, not a Nike”)

privacy.title: Privacy & contact
privacy.intro: Valyo is a project under development. This page plainly explains what happens with your photos and how to reach us.
privacy.dataBody: The photos you send are passed to our AI provider, Anthropic, to perform the identification and estimate. Valyo does not store your photos on its own servers: they're used to answer your request and are not kept on our side afterward.
privacy.logsBody: Our server logs only contain limited technical information (error category, diagnostic id, anonymized usage statistics) — never the content of your photos or the details of an analysis result.
privacy.rateLimitBody: Your IP address is briefly held in memory to limit abusive scanning, then forgotten — it's never written to disk or shared.
privacy.disclaimerBody: Valyo is an actively developing project. We don't claim formal GDPR compliance at this stage, nor a guaranteed deletion timeline beyond what's described here. This page will be updated if that changes.
privacy.contactBody: For any question, write to us at <email>info@m2s-consulting.be</email>. Valyo is a project published by M2S Consulting.
